google.comment: CONTROLLED AMBIGUITY FIXTURE ONLY. The google namespace can be contributed to by multiple distributions. google-auth documents the google.auth package (https://google-auth.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/google.html); google-api-core contains modules under google.api_core (https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-python/tree/main/packages/google-api-core). A bare import google does not identify which subpackage/provider the code intends. Do not treat this as a universal mapping for every google.* import.

internal_reporting_sdk_demo.comment: PRIVATE controlled validation fixture. This represents a hypothetical organization-only SDK not published on public PyPI. The classifier currently looks for the word private in this mapping comment to exercise PRIVATE_OR_UNKNOWN. Use this only for validation, not as a real verified import-to-distribution mapping.
